description:
Relocate PR #5's extension framework from octo_pi_agent to octo_pi_coder, matching upstream pi-mono's package layout. Upstream puts ExtensionRunner and friends in packages/coding-agent/src/core/extensions/, not in packages/agent/.

## Steps

STEP 1 — Move modules:
- apps/octo_pi_agent/lib/octo_pi/agent/extension.ex → apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/extension/extension.ex (rename module to OctoPi.Coder.Extension)
- apps/octo_pi_agent/lib/octo_pi/agent/extension_runner.ex → apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/extension/runner.ex (rename module to OctoPi.Coder.Extension.Runner)

STEP 2 — Move tests to corresponding locations:
- apps/octo_pi_agent/test/octo_pi/agent/extension*.exs → apps/octo_pi_coder/test/octo_pi/coder/extension/

STEP 3 — Update all references across the umbrella (Session in agent app, all aliases, all imports).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] File apps/octo_pi_agent/lib/octo_pi/agent/extension.ex does NOT exist
- [ ] File apps/octo_pi_agent/lib/octo_pi/agent/extension_runner.ex does NOT exist
- [ ] File apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/extension/extension.ex EXISTS, defines module OctoPi.Coder.Extension
- [ ] File apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/extension/runner.ex EXISTS, defines module OctoPi.Coder.Extension.Runner
- [ ] `grep -rn "OctoPi\.Agent\.Extension\b" apps/ --include="*.ex" --include="*.exs"` returns 0 matches
- [ ] `grep -rn "OctoPi\.Agent\.ExtensionRunner" apps/ --include="*.ex" --include="*.exs"` returns 0 matches
- [ ] `mix test` passes
- [ ] `mix compile --warnings-as-errors` clean

## Dependencies

title: Move Extension framework: agent app to coder app
